title: Enhancing the De-identification of Personally Identifiable Information in Educational Data

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the True Positive Rate (recall) of Personally Identifiable Information (PII) detection models for male versus female student names using the Equality of Opportunity metric and Mann-Whitney U tests.

Evaluating the True Positive Rate (recall) of Personally Identifiable Information (PII) detection models for student names across four continental cultural regions (Asia, Americas, Europe, Africa) using the Equality of Opportunity metric and Mann-Whitney U tests.
